types.description: Red integral LED light block, 24 V AC/DC, screw clamps, for 22 mm Harmony XB4/XB5 heads

modelingNotes: The library preserves the spelling ZBV-B4. The Schneider ZBVB4 sheet and historical ZBV B4 selection row support the presentation-separator mapping.
Bare red integral LED light block only. Head, fixing collar, contacts, transformer and test-light accessories are separately specified.

X1/X2 lamp schematic visually verified on manufacturer image XB4_632_CPSCT16033 linked from the exact ZBVB4 product page: https://download.se.com/files?default_image=DefaultProductImage.png&p_Doc_Ref=XB4_632_CPSCT16033&p_File_Type=rendition_1500_jpg. The image is family marked ZBV; exact production revision is not asserted.
Rated supply 24 V AC/DC, AC 50/60 Hz; operating limits 19.2-30 V DC and 21.6-26.4 V AC. No polarity assignment is inferred from adjacent models.
Exact datasheet states 18 mA consumption; linked image shows 14 mA (Ieff). No scalar current rating is encoded because these disagree.
Screw clamp torque 0.8-1.2 N m; up to two 1.5 mm2 conductors with cable ends; minimum one 0.22 mm2 without cable end. Shared terminal policy permits the documented two-conductor connection.

Both supply terminals required under lamp modeling policy. Load membership does not join nets; there is no factory fixed wire link between X1 and X2. No surrounding collar/panel bonding path is asserted.

connectionCoverage.notes: Two external screw-clamp lamp connections X1 and X2, supported by the exact product-linked body schematic and product sheet. Bare light block only; no contact, PE/bond, shield or communication terminals. Separately ordered heads, collars and accessories and their bonding interfaces are outside this scope.

X1.description: Lamp supply terminal X1; no DC polarity assigned

X2.description: Lamp supply terminal X2; no DC polarity assigned
